commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; git fetch --no-tags origin main >/dev/null; HEAD=$(git rev-parse origin/main); echo source_head=$HEAD; test "$HEAD" = 53cccf4fa39525febf54e0a57f65796efbd51812; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); test "$SERIAL" = RFCT70L7E8J; echo serial=$SERIAL; PID=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof io.blueeye 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' || true); echo pid_now=${PID:-none}; FILE=cache/session_exports/blueeye-session-export.json; if adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye test -s "$FILE"; then echo export_present=1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye ls -l "$FILE"; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat "$FILE" > /tmp/tracker-current-export-cache-recover-v2.json; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,sqlite3,subprocess,os
p='/tmp/tracker-current-export-cache-recover-v2.json'
b=open(p,'rb').read(); d=json.loads(b); s=d['fieldMvpDiagnostics']['scanner']; i=s['ingest']
print('export_bytes='+str(len(b))); print('export_sha256='+hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()); print('scanner_state='+str(s.get('state'))); print('startedAt='+str(s.get('startedAt'))); print('lastBleSeenAt='+str(s.get('lastBleSeenAt')))
keys=['rawBleCallbacksTotal','enqueueAcceptedTotal','enqueueRejectedTotal','queueDroppedTotal','coalescedTotal','processingStartedTotal','processingSucceededTotal','processingFailedTotal','persistedDeviceUpdatesTotal','signalSamplesWrittenTotal','signalSampleWriteFailuresTotal','queueDepth','queueHighWaterMark','maxQueueWaitMs','maxProcessingDurationMs']
for k in keys: print(f'{k}={i.get(k)}')
raw=i['rawBleCallbacksTotal']; accepted=i['enqueueAcceptedTotal']; rejected=i['enqueueRejectedTotal']; coalesced=i['coalescedTotal']; started=i['processingStartedTotal']; succeeded=i['processingSucceededTotal']; failed=i['processingFailedTotal']
assert raw>0; assert raw==accepted+coalesced+rejected; assert rejected==0; assert i['queueDroppedTotal']==0; assert failed==0; assert i['signalSampleWriteFailuresTotal']==0; assert i['queueDepth']==0; assert started==succeeded+failed; assert accepted==started; assert i['signalSamplesWrittenTotal']>0
print('CURRENT_INGEST_ACCOUNTING_PASS')
PY
adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as io.blueeye cp databases/tracker_database cache/tracker-cache-recover.db; adb -s "$SERIAL" exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat cache/tracker-cache-recover.db > /tmp/tracker-cache-recover.db; sqlite3 /tmp/tracker-cache-recover.db 'PRAGMA integrity_check; select count(*) from devices; select count(*) from signal_samples; select count(*) from follow_me_observations;' | sed 's/^/db=/'; python3 - <<'PY'
import json,sqlite3
d=json.load(open('/tmp/tracker-current-export-cache-recover-v2.json')); c=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/tracker-cache-recover.db'); dev=c.execute('select count(*) from devices').fetchone()[0]; sam=c.execute('select count(*) from signal_samples').fetchone()[0]; print('export_deviceCount='+str(d.get('deviceCount'))); print('export_sampleCount='+str(d.get('sampleCount'))); print('db_devices='+str(dev)); print('db_samples='+str(sam)); assert d.get('deviceCount')==dev; assert d.get('sampleCount')==sam; print('EXPORT_DB_RECONCILIATION_PASS')
PY
echo PHASE3_CURRENT_EXPORT_CACHE_RECOVERY_PASS; else echo export_present=0; exit 4; fi
